seo.meta_title: Is Noodles & Company Closing? 2026 Closures Explained
seo.meta_description: Noodles & Company isn't going out of business, but it closed 34 restaurants in the first nine months of 2026. How many are left and why it is closing stores.

question: Is Noodles & Company Closing?
quick_answer: No, Noodles & Company as a whole is not closing, but it is shutting down underperforming restaurants. The chain closed 42 locations in 2025 and 34 more in the first three quarters of 2026. As of September 29, 2026, it had 383 restaurants in 31 states. Sales at the remaining restaurants have been rising, and the company says some customers from closed stores move to nearby locations.
key_facts: 383 restaurants in 31 states as of Sept. 29, 2026
42 closures in 2025 and 34 in the first nine months of 2026
Closures target underperforming restaurants, not the whole chain
Same-store sales were up 9.5% in the third quarter of 2026
A board review of strategic options, including a possible sale, is still ongoing

body.heading: Why Noodles & Company is closing restaurants
body.text: Noodles & Company calls the closures part of a portfolio optimization plan. Instead of keeping every location open, it is closing restaurants that lose money or have weak sales, often when their leases come up for renewal. In January 2026 the company said it planned to close another 30 to 35 restaurants during the year, after closing 33 company-owned and nine franchised locations in 2025. The company has not published a full list of which stores will close.

body.heading: How many locations are left
body.text: According to its quarterly filing, Noodles & Company had 383 restaurants in 31 states as of September 29, 2026: 306 company-owned and 77 franchised. That is down from more than 460 at the start of 2025. The company has said it has identified more restaurants it may close on or before their next lease renewal dates, so the count could keep falling.

body.heading: How the remaining restaurants are doing
body.text: The closures have come alongside better sales at the restaurants that stay open. In the third quarter of 2026, comparable restaurant sales rose 9.5% across the system, and average sales per restaurant rose about 15%. The company says part of that comes from customers of closed stores moving to nearby Noodles locations, plus menu changes and value deals.

body.heading: Is Noodles & Company being sold?
body.text: In September 2025, the board started a review of strategic alternatives, which can include refranchising or selling all or part of the business. As of the company's November 2026 filing, that review was still in process and no sale had been announced. The company also extended its credit facility to November 2027 and has said it will need new financing or other capital before then.

body.heading: How to check if your local Noodles is open
body.text: The quickest way is to search for your location in the Noodles & Company app or the store locator on its website. Closed restaurants are removed from the locator, and many local news outlets report closures in their area. For current prices at locations that are open, see our Noodles & Company menu page.

faqs.q: Is Noodles & Company going out of business?
faqs.a: No. It is closing underperforming restaurants, but the chain still had 383 locations as of September 29, 2026.

faqs.a: 34 in the first three quarters of 2026, after 42 closures in 2025.
